title: DataLabs · ANP (combustíveis)
description: Produto de dados da ANP: cada carga (audit.pipeline_step_runs), perfil do lote, qualidade (health checks + dbt/Elementary), preços (gold.ag_anp_preco_semanal) e o RAG que consome a gold.

list.name: uf
list.label: UF
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT uf FROM gold.ag_anp_preco_semanal ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT uf FROM gold.ag_anp_preco_semanal ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Última carga
panels.description: Tempo desde o último landing com sucesso. Fonte semanal: alerta em 8 dias, crítico em 15.

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - MAX(finished_at)) FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND step IN ('landing_semanal', 'landing_mensal') AND status = 'success'
SELECT rows_out FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND step IN ('landing_semanal', 'landing_mensal') AND status = 'success' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Arquivos com falha
panels.description: Arquivos rejeitados no landing (ex.: schema drift) no período.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(files_failed), 0) FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND step IN ('landing_semanal', 'landing_mensal') AND $__timeFilter(started_at)

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('success', 'skipped')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND status <> 'running' AND $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Última execução da DAG
panels.description: Duração ponta a ponta do último run da dag_dbt_anp.

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM end_date - start_date) FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = 'dag_dbt_anp' AND end_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY end_date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Coletas na gold
panels.description: Lido do agregado (Σ qtd_coletas = linhas da fato; reconciliado por teste dbt).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qtd_coletas), 0) FROM gold.ag_anp_preco_semanal

SELECT started_at, step, status, ROUND(duration_s::numeric, 1) AS duracao_s, files_ok AS arquivos_ok, files_failed AS arquivos_falha, rows_in AS linhas_lidas, rows_out AS linhas_gravadas, rows_rejected AS rejeitadas, LEFT(error_message, 80) AS erro FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND step IN ('landing_semanal', 'landing_mensal') AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Tasks mais lentas da dag_dbt_anp (média no período)
panels.description: Onde o tempo da DAG vai: landing, modelos dbt (Cosmos) e checks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT task_id, COUNT(*) AS execucoes, ROUND(AVG(duration)::numeric, 1) AS media_s, ROUND(MAX(duration)::numeric, 1) AS max_s, MAX(end_date) AS ultima FROM task_instance WHERE dag_id = 'dag_dbt_anp' AND state = 'success' AND duration IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(start_date) GROUP BY task_id ORDER BY media_s DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Duração por step
panels.description: Cada ponto é uma execução. Ganhos de performance (índices, volumes) aparecem aqui.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, step AS metric, duration_s AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE (pipeline = 'anp' OR (pipeline = 'obs' AND step = 'health_checks_anp')) AND status IN ('success', 'skipped') AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Perfil do lote — o dado mudou? (metrics → profile, gravado pelo landing)
Linhas por produto em cada carga

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.started_at AS time, p.key AS metric, p.value::numeric AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(r.metrics -> 'profile' -> 'rows_by_product') p WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND step IN ('landing_semanal', 'landing_mensal') AND r.status = 'success' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Preço médio por produto no lote (antes do dbt)
panels.description: Perfil calculado no landing: um salto aqui, antes de chegar à gold, indica arquivo anômalo. GLP (botijão) no eixo da direita.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.started_at AS time, p.key AS metric, p.value::numeric AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(r.metrics -> 'profile' -> 'avg_price_by_product') p WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND step IN ('landing_semanal', 'landing_mensal') AND r.status = 'success' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cobertura por carga
panels.description: Queda brusca de municípios/postos = arquivo incompleto. CNPJs no eixo da direita.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.started_at AS time, (r.metrics -> 'profile' ->> 'municipios')::int AS municipios, (r.metrics -> 'profile' ->> 'bandeiras')::int AS bandeiras, (r.metrics -> 'profile' ->> 'cnpjs')::int AS cnpjs FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs r WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND step IN ('landing_semanal', 'landing_mensal') AND r.status = 'success' AND r.metrics ? 'profile' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Volume da última carga vs. mediana das 10 anteriores

targets.rawSql: SELECT step, last_run_at AS ultima_carga, last_rows_out AS linhas, ROUND(median_rows_out::numeric) AS mediana_anteriores, deviation_pct AS desvio_pct FROM obs.v_step_volume_baseline WHERE pipeline = 'anp' ORDER BY step

panels.title: Qualidade — health checks (audit.data_quality_checks) e testes dbt (Elementary)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM obs.v_check_last_result WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND status IN ('fail', 'error')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM obs.v_check_last_result WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND status = 'warn'

panels.title: Checks suspensos
panels.description: Suspensão explícita no checks.yml (com motivo). Dívida a quitar.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM obs.v_check_last_result WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND status = 'skipped' AND message LIKE 'suspended:%'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (test_unique_id, column_name, test_sub_type) status FROM elementary.elementary_test_results WHERE (test_unique_id ILIKE '%anp%' OR table_name IN ('dm_postos', 'dm_produtos')) ORDER BY test_unique_id, column_name, test_sub_type, detected_at DESC) t WHERE status IN ('fail', 'error')

SELECT check_name AS check, check_type AS tipo, status, severity AS severidade, observed_value AS observado, expected AS esperado, LEFT(message, 90) AS mensagem, checked_at FROM obs.v_check_last_result WHERE pipeline = 'anp' ORDER BY status, check_name

panels.title: Testes dbt ANP — último resultado não aprovado

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(test_short_name, test_type) AS teste, table_name AS modelo, column_name AS coluna, status, failures AS registros, detected_at FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (test_unique_id, column_name, test_sub_type) * FROM elementary.elementary_test_results WHERE (test_unique_id ILIKE '%anp%' OR table_name IN ('dm_postos', 'dm_produtos')) ORDER BY test_unique_id, column_name, test_sub_type, detected_at DESC) t WHERE status <> 'pass' ORDER BY failures DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(semana)::timestamp) * 1000 FROM gold.ag_anp_preco_semanal

panels.title: Postos na última semana
panels.description: Maior nº de postos entre os produtos de cada UF (um posto vende vários produtos).

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(qtd_postos) FROM ( SELECT uf, MAX(qtd_postos) AS qtd_postos FROM gold.ag_anp_preco_semanal WHERE uf IN ($uf) AND semana = (SELECT MAX(semana) FROM gold.ag_anp_preco_semanal) GROUP BY uf) t

panels.title: Gasolina — preço médio (última semana)
panels.description: Média ponderada pelas coletas (nunca a média das médias por UF).

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(preco_medio * qtd_coletas) / NULLIF(SUM(qtd_coletas), 0) FROM gold.ag_anp_preco_semanal WHERE produto = 'GASOLINA' AND uf IN ($uf) AND semana = (SELECT MAX(semana) FROM gold.ag_anp_preco_semanal)

panels.title: Etanol / gasolina
panels.description: Regra de bolso: abaixo de 70% o etanol compensa.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT produto, SUM(preco_medio * qtd_coletas) / NULLIF(SUM(qtd_coletas), 0) AS p FROM gold.ag_anp_preco_semanal WHERE produto IN ('ETANOL', 'GASOLINA') AND uf IN ($uf) AND semana = (SELECT MAX(semana) FROM gold.ag_anp_preco_semanal) GROUP BY produto) SELECT 100 * MAX(p) FILTER (WHERE produto = 'ETANOL') / NULLIF(MAX(p) FILTER (WHERE produto = 'GASOLINA'), 0) FROM s

panels.title: Preço médio semanal por produto
panels.description: GLP (botijão 13 kg) no eixo da direita.

targets.rawSql: SELECT semana::timestamp AS time, produto AS metric, SUM(preco_medio * qtd_coletas) / NULLIF(SUM(qtd_coletas), 0) AS value FROM gold.ag_anp_preco_semanal WHERE uf IN ($uf) AND $__timeFilter(semana) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Maiores variações: última semana vs. anterior

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS ( SELECT uf, produto, semana, preco_medio, LAG(preco_medio) OVER (PARTITION BY uf, produto ORDER BY semana) AS anterior, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY uf, produto ORDER BY semana DESC) AS rn FROM gold.ag_anp_preco_semanal WHERE uf IN ($uf) AND semana >= (SELECT MAX(semana) FROM gold.ag_anp_preco_semanal) - 7) SELECT uf, produto, semana, ROUND(preco_medio::numeric, 3) AS preco, ROUND(anterior::numeric, 3) AS anterior, ROUND((100 * (preco_medio / anterior - 1))::numeric, 2) AS variacao_pct FROM s WHERE rn = 1 AND anterior > 0 ORDER BY ABS(preco_medio / anterior - 1) DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT uf, ROUND(AVG(preco_medio) FILTER (WHERE produto = 'GASOLINA')::numeric, 3) AS gasolina, ROUND(AVG(preco_medio) FILTER (WHERE produto = 'ETANOL')::numeric, 3) AS etanol, ROUND(AVG(preco_medio) FILTER (WHERE produto = 'DIESEL S10')::numeric, 3) AS diesel_s10, ROUND(AVG(preco_medio) FILTER (WHERE produto = 'GNV')::numeric, 3) AS gnv, ROUND(AVG(preco_medio) FILTER (WHERE produto = 'GLP')::numeric, 2) AS glp, SUM(qtd_coletas) AS coletas FROM gold.ag_anp_preco_semanal WHERE uf IN ($uf) AND semana = (SELECT MAX(semana) FROM gold.ag_anp_preco_semanal) GROUP BY uf ORDER BY gasolina DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Último sync do vector store
panels.description: incremental = só o delta da gold; full = store vazio, troca de modelo ou pedido.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(metrics ->> 'sync_mode', 'full (legado)') FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'rag' AND step = 'build_context' AND status IN ('success', 'skipped') ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai.rag_context_anp

panels.title: Paridade gold (GO) ↔ vetores
panels.description: Vetores − coletas de GO na gold. 0 = o RAG enxerga exatamente a gold.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai.rag_context_anp) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qtd_coletas), 0) FROM gold.ag_anp_preco_semanal WHERE uf = 'GO')

panels.title: Acurácia do último gate
panels.description: Menor entre roteamento e valor no golden set (gate: 90%).

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100 * LEAST(acuracia_roteamento, acuracia_valor) FROM ai.rag_eval_summary ORDER BY executado_em DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT started_at, status, ROUND(duration_s::numeric) AS duracao_s, metrics ->> 'sync_mode' AS modo, (metrics ->> 'chunks_new')::int AS novos, (metrics ->> 'chunks_stale')::int AS obsoletos, (metrics ->> 'embed_rows_per_s')::numeric AS linhas_por_s, metrics ->> 'model' AS modelo, LEFT(error_message, 60) AS erro FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'rag' AND step = 'build_context' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Velocidade de embedding por modelo
panels.description: Linhas/s no cálculo dos embeddings (CPU). e5-base ≈ 6-7, e5-small ≈ 26 no lab.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, metrics ->> 'model' AS metric, (metrics ->> 'embed_rows_per_s')::numeric AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'rag' AND step = 'build_context' AND metrics ? 'embed_rows_per_s' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1
